verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documented compatibility layer, command aliases, or interface conventions that mirror an incumbent package manager such as apt, MacPorts, or Nix. The Brewfile is only compared by analogy to package.json/Gemfile, which is not command compatibility. The user-editable aliases feature is an adjacent building block, not a migration capability.

support.subject: As a switcher, I can keep using familiar commands and interface conventions from the incumbent tool while adopting this manager
